Meter 0984179 Hoff Heller Unit #22 CDP was shut-in at approximately 9:20 AM 
today (February 17, 2000).  

On Wednesday, February 16, the meter was found flowing 25 lb dew point gas.  
The pumper was given 24 hours to correct the problem.  On February 17, the 
meter was found flowing 40 lb dew point gas.

If you have any questions please call me at 36449.

Thanks
Gary H
